notes: Example only. Fake HOME paths — do not point this file at a real oauth store.
Copy to a gitignored path (e.g. jobs/agy-account-pool.json) and fill in real profile HOMEs locally.
Never put access/id/refresh tokens, oauth JSON, or GEMINI_API_KEY in the pool file.
GEMINI_API_KEY mode is not Google AI Pro quota. Serial dispatch only; one HOME per spawn.
cooldown_sec is seconds for cooldown_mode=duration (default 300). day_boundary waits until the next machine-local midnight. Quota and rate-limit use cooldown, not exhausted.
